description: Liberia - CLSG SW and MV Project Location-LNEA is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand, Project sites", published or maintained by NRECA International (NRECA International). This layer contains town location that is Under Implementation from AfDB funded CLSG SW and MV project. There are also some additional settlements cluster and demand characteristics that identified under NEA project and proposed to be considered under the scope of CLSG SW and MV project. Coverage: Liberia. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy demand, Project sites, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
